decisions.reason: The inbound SMS API has been presented on its own page for two consecutive years, extends the firm's established messaging platform at low marginal cost, and fits the announced direction toward integrated enterprise cloud communications, so management has every reason to persist with it.

Launched only in 2024 and publicly presented on its own page, the email-to-SMS gateway builds on existing infrastructure and is central to the multichannel strategy, and any weak early uptake can still be attributed to a normal ramp-up period.

The SMS-to-email gateway complements Product B as part of a visible, newly committed messaging bundle, so dropping it after one year would undermine the recent launch decision and the firm's announced channel-integration direction.
